original_benchmark.notes: 1,403 single-page PDFs with 7,019 unit tests in 7 JSONL files (plus one auto-added baseline test per page). Upstream runs OCR pipelines / VLM APIs per page via olmocr.bench.convert and scores with olmocr.bench.benchmark.

harbor_adapter.notes: One task per PDF page. Grading uses the unmodified upstream olmocr test code (pinned commit f7cfe4c2). Official score = mean of per-JSONL pass rates, recomputed with olmocr-bench-aggregate. Parity plan pending team confirmation.
